_comment: The warehouse-only lane: jaffle-golden's questions and conversation over jaffle-golden's seed, on a database-only workspace (fixtures/jaffle-warehouse-golden: synced catalog, drafted and certified joins, no dbt manifest, no blocks, no metrics). A database-only project has no dbt metrics, so a case that must be governed in jaffle-golden must here return the right rows with any honest label (certified, governed or review required). The lane is floor-gated: it fails only when fewer cases pass than baseline.json's floor.askGolden.
